parameters.help_en: The region ID in which to create the KVCacheStore. You can call DescribeRegions to query the list of available regions
parameters.help_zh: 创建 KVCacheStore 的地域 ID。可通过 DescribeRegions 查询已开通的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call DescribeZones to query the list of zones in the specified region
parameters.help_zh: 可用区 ID。可通过 DescribeZones 查询指定地域下的可用区列表
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The KVCacheStore name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters from the Unicode letter category (including English and Chinese characters) and digits. The name can contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). If this parameter is not specified, the default value is the KVCacheStore ID
parameters.help_zh: KVCacheStore 名称，长度为2～128 个字符，支持 Unicode 中 letter 分类下的字符（包括英文、中文等）和数字。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。如果没有指定该参数，默认值为KVCacheStore ID
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity in GiB. The minimum capacity is 300 TiB (307200 GiB), and the capacity is scaled in increments of 300 TiB
parameters.help_zh: 存储容量，单位为 GiB。起步容量 300 TiB（307200 GiB），以 300 TiB 为步长扩容
parameters.name: capacity

parameters.help_en: The HPN cluster ID, which is used to create an affinity scheduling relationship between the KVCacheStore and the specified HPN cluster. After creation, the KVCacheStore may have affinity relationships with multiple HPN clusters based on network topology. You can call GetKVCacheStore to query the available HPN clusters
parameters.help_zh: HPN 集群编号，用于创建 KVCacheStore 与指定 HPN 集群的亲和调度关系。创建完成后，KVCacheStore 可能根据网络关系与多个 HPN 集群存在亲和关系。可通过GetKVCacheStore可用的 HPN 集群
parameters.name: hpn_zone

parameters.help_en: The KVCacheStore description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://. Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: KVCacheStore 描述，长度为 2~256 个英文或中文字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。默认值为空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The billing method. Valid values: POSTPAY (pay-as-you-go). Default value: POSTPAY
parameters.help_zh: 付费方式。取值：POSTPAY（按量付费）。默认为 POSTPAY
parameters.name: payment_type

fields.help_en: The tag key of the resource
fields.name: tag_key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the resource
fields.name: tag_value

parameters.help_en: The list of resource tag key-value pairs. A maximum of 20 tags are supported. This overrides the parent TagDTO type and uses the same Tag type as the Get/List response
parameters.help_zh: 资源标签键值对列表，最多支持 20 个标签（覆盖父类 TagDTO 类型，使用与 Get/List 返回一致的 Tag 类型）
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The client token used to ensure idempotence of the request. The token can be up to 64 characters in length. Use a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求幂等的客户端 Token，最长 64 个字符。建议使用 UUID
parameters.name: client_token

OrderId.description_zh: 本次创建产生的订单 ID
